streaming.question: Where is my order 2048?
streaming.answer: Your order left our Riyadh warehouse this morning. It is with the courier now and arrives on Thursday between 2 and 6 pm. You will get a text message one hour before delivery, and you can change the time from the tracking page if you are not home.
streaming.earlier_1: Hi! How can I help with your order today?
streaming.earlier_2: I want to check on a delivery.
streaming.earlier_3: Of course. Which order is it?

new_count.incoming: Update: the courier is 10 minutes away.
new_count.first: Your order is packed and ready.
new_count.hint: Scroll up, then receive a message.
